title: Asset purchase — Lindmere Preserves LLC
forum: Minnesota private asset purchase; no court proceeding

documents.title: Cart purchase agreement excerpt
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Section 3.4 fixes the equipment objection date seventeen calendar days after the asset purchase agreement was signed. Section 6.1 fixes closing twenty-seven calendar days after the asset purchase agreement was signed. Both are express dates in the agreement with no automatic weekend extension.

documents.title: Equipment list
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. The cart includes a copper kettle, a vapor condenser, and six jam display trays. The condenser’s replacement filter is missing.

clientFacing.status: We are checking the cart equipment before closing.
nextSteps: Confirm whether the missing filter needs a seller credit.
